name: command
title: Command
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova command, fixed: Renders the separator as a presentational rule, since a listbox may only contain options and groups. Its rows are 32px tall (min-h-8) with an 8px radius, as in every menu. Its input is the page's colour inside a hairline, as a search field is drawn (the input grey for both its fill and its border drew a darker rim, like an inset shadow). Its value is always controlled inside (`value`, or `defaultValue`, with `onValueChange` called either way): the arrows scroll the highlighted option into view and make it the input's aria-activedescendant even when the options don't render again (memoized, or compiled by the React Compiler); the active descendant is named on mount, for a value the app sets and when the options are rendered anew; and mounted with a query, the value given stays highlighted until the reader acts, where cmdk would highlight the first hit. CommandDialog size="fixed" is 32rem tall and centred whatever its results; size="wide" the same at 42rem wide, for a palette of groups and shortcuts. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md).
